title: Next.js RAG app on Vercel: profile-derived signals must reach responsive, deployment and rag-evaluation
context: Field trial 3, AgentDesk. The repository profile described a Next.js frontend, Qdrant, Gemini, and a Vercel production URL.
observed_failure: signalsFromProfile had no derivation path for rag, deploy-config or responsive, and the profile had no way to declare them. Applicability marked responsive, mobile-viewport, deployment and rag-evaluation not applicable, and the skill's rule 'fix the profile, not the verdict' could not be followed.
reasoning_notes: rag is derived from llm + a vector store; deploy-config from a declared environment with a URL; responsive has no reliable derivation, so it is declared with evidence.
